notes: CEO - Creative Engineering Operations v1.1.1. Your panels, your layout: drag any panel by its top bar and put it anywhere - park the mixer on the left or right side, or float it free. Every panel has a working X to close it and a minimize that rolls it up out of the way and restores with one click. The mixer now scrolls up and down with the mouse wheel, all the way to its bottom row, as well as sideways. Your layout is remembered between launches. Mac: universal build for Intel and Apple Silicon, macOS 10.15 and up.
